limitations: No statement about conjugacy classes, higher nilpotency indices, or arbitrary two-step Lie algebras. An equivalent older finite symplectic nilpotent-orbit calculation may exist.
scientific_integrity: Exact all-characteristic symbolic proof; direct finite-field enumeration supplies computational spot checks, not an infinite proof. Only square-zero linear derivations of nondegenerate finite Heisenberg Lie algebras are counted. Historical priority and independent scientific validation are not asserted.
title: Exact rank spectra of square-zero derivations of finite Heisenberg Lie algebras
